name: Forever C Plus
description: Forever C Plus is a powerful Nutraceutical tablet enriched with Amla Extract and Hesperidin, delivering an effective Vitamin C boost for all-day immune and antioxidant support. Each pack contains 100 tablets (1.3g each), specially formulated for adults. Amla (Indian Gooseberry) is one of nature's richest sources of Vitamin C, while Hesperidin — a naturally occurring bioflavonoid found in citrus — enhances absorption and provides additional antioxidant benefits. Suitable for adults. Recommended usage: One tablet twice daily.
usage: One tablet to be taken by adults, two times daily.

name: Radiance by Forever Toner
description: Radiance by Forever Toner is a gentle, soothing Aloe and Saffron-based facial toner crafted to tighten pores and replenish moisture after cleansing. Enriched with Licorice for brightening and Cica (Centella Asiatica) for calming and repairing the skin barrier, this toner gives you a radiant, even-toned glow with every use. Sulphate Free, Paraben Free, and Dermatologically Tested — this formula is safe for all skin types. Made in India with love.
usage: Spray toner on a clean face, avoiding eyes. Always follow with a moisturizer for a radiant glow.

name: Forever Tulsi Van Honey
description: Forever Tulsi Van Honey is a pure, natural honey blend combining the goodness of Honeydew Honey and Blossom Honey, infused with the essence of Tulsi (Holy Basil) — one of Ayurveda's most revered herbs. Sourced naturally and free from artificial additives, this 500g squeeze bottle delivers rich, earthy sweetness with the added wellness benefits of Tulsi. Perfect as a daily immunity booster, a natural sweetener in teas, or a wholesome spread. A true gift from nature's forests.
keyFeatures: Natural blend of Honeydew Honey & Blossom Honey
usage: Use as a natural sweetener in beverages, spread on bread, or consume directly for daily wellness.
